summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend retest confirms the newly fixed admin group endpoints now pass: /api/admin/grupos?codigo_grupo=PRECBH2602000_20003 returns items=[] and /api/admin/grupos/PRECBH2602000_20003 returns notas_por_periodo=[]. Previously fixed endpoints also still pass with academic-only values: /historical 2025-2 n=82155 and 2026-1 n=82036, student historico has no fuera-de-malla notes, executive and academic totals match DB academic-only, and docente grupos-comparativa excludes the target. However, the fix is still not comprehensive across all tableros: Admin > Docentes detail endpoint /api/admin/docentes/{docente_id}/grupos still returns Inglés Fuera de la Malla groups with historico_notas/promedios, and the frontend displays those averages.

critical.issue: Still returns non-academic Inglés Fuera de la Malla groups with historical averages. Examples: PRECBH2602000_20005 promedio=3.77 n=87, PRECBH2602000_20004 promedio=3.76 n=166, PRECBH2602000_20002 promedio=3.62 n=198, PRECBH2602000_20001 promedio=3.54 n=134, and target PRECBH2602000_20003 promedio=3.50 n=190. This violates 'todos los tableros' because Admin Docentes detail still considers outside-malla English in notas/promedios.

minor.issue: items=[] now passes, but total still returns 1 because total is counted before the post-query academic filter. This is a pagination/count consistency issue, not the main promedio calculation failure.

integration_issues.flow: Admin > Docentes > detalle de docente > Grupos asignados
integration_issues.issue: frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx calls /admin/docentes/{id}/grupos and renders each historico_notas promedio in the Histórico column, so the backend failure is user-visible in the Admin Docentes tablero.

action_items: Fix /api/admin/docentes/{docente_id}/grupos to exclude non-academic groups or at minimum return historico_notas=[] for groups whose programa/facultad/codigo marks Extensión or Inglés Fuera de la Malla.

Use the shared is_academic_note() group metadata guard and academic_notes_match() note aggregation filter in that endpoint, matching the fixes already applied to /api/admin/grupos and /api/admin/grupos/{codigo_grupo}.
Optionally adjust /api/admin/grupos total to count post-filtered items so items=[] does not return total=1 for suppressed non-academic groups.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/admin_router.py lines ~428-441: docente_grupos() returns all db.grupos for a docente and aggregates historico_notas with raw match {docente_id, codigo_asignatura}; it does not call is_academic_note() or academic_notes_match().
/app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx lines ~1383 and ~1517-1519: Admin Docentes detail consumes this endpoint and displays h.promedio.toFixed(2), making the non-academic averages visible in the UI.
The last fix only covered /api/admin/grupos list/detail; a sibling Admin Docentes tablero still exposes the same class of non-academic notas/promedios.

rca_of_the_issue: The final admin group fix was applied only to /api/admin/grupos and /api/admin/grupos/{codigo_grupo}. The Admin Docentes detail endpoint remains on the old raw aggregation path: it lists all docente groups and computes historico_notas by docente_id + codigo_asignatura without filtering group metadata or applying academic_notes_match(). Reproduction: login superadmin, get target group docente_id from /api/admin/grupos/PRECBH2602000_20003, then GET /api/admin/docentes/{docente_id}/grupos and observe Inglés Fuera de la Malla groups with historical promedio values.
